title: The Dragon's Heart Whispers
summary: The party harvested Venomfang's corpse like professionals — 13 liters of blood, 43 pounds of meat, wings worth 6,000gp, two horns, four sets of scales, and the dragon's breath pouch, all extracted through a gauntlet of escalating survival checks. Then Valrex went for the heart. He needed a 25. He got a 23. In the moments after the failure, something settled behind his eyes that wasn't entirely his — Venomfang's pride and spite, whispering from where Valrex's faith used to be. It manifested almost immediately: he walked north toward the dragon's tower, claiming its horde before he realized he'd said 'my.' Then the dragon cultists arrived in green and black robes, Valrex's next Guiding Bolt fired the wrong color, and the session ended with his hand around the cult leader's throat and three nat 20s on the enemy's initiative.

best_moments.title: Reidoth's Verdict
best_moments.description: After staring at Venomfang's corpse for a long moment, Reidoth let out a low, quiet whistle. The old druid — who had spent years watching everything in Thundertree fail and die — looked at the party and said the four words that completed the arc: 'I'll be damned.' Then, practically: 'If you're set on carving him up, best do it before the scavengers catch the scent.' He'd believed in them just enough to fight. Now he believed all the way.

quotes.speaker: Alex/GM (Reidoth)
quotes.text: I'll be damned. You actually did it. If you're set on carving him up, best do it before the scavengers catch the scent.

quotes.speaker: Darren/Valrex
quotes.text: It's funny how everybody shows up when it's time to harvest a dragon. Not missing out on that part.

best_moments.title: The Dragon Harvest
best_moments.description: Valrex — who had spent all of last session losing to spiders — led the harvest with a plus-five in survival and a score to settle. Belden assisted. Semaj maintained Guidance the entire time. The results: 13 liters of dragon's blood, 43 pounds of meat on a nat 20 double-yield, 8 claws, 22 teeth, 3 fangs, 6 lots of dragon bone (1,800gp), one dragon skull, two pristine wings (6,000gp total on Belden's nat 20), both horns (1,300gp). Kaelia was running math. The numbers got large. 'We're making bank on this dragon, guys.'

quotes.speaker: Alex/GM
quotes.text: Looks like meat's back on the menu, you boys.

quotes.speaker: Jen/Kaelia
quotes.text: We're making bank on this dragon, guys.

quotes.speaker: Sean/Belden
quotes.text: I need you to take this bone and make me a hammer. And then on both sides of the hammer, put two little teeth sticking out. That'd be awesome.

best_moments.title: Belden Gets Both Horns
best_moments.description: The horn check was DC 16, fused deep into the skull. Both inspirations used. Both horns gave with grinding cracks. Belden heaved them free with a shout, held them up, and stood there for a moment just breathing hard. The brass horn that summoned Venomfang in session 16 has been eclipsed by the horns taken from Venomfang's skull. Each is worth 650gp and can be crafted into arcane staves. The GM noted that they absorb magical enchantments easily. Sean made immediately clear he intends to use one as an instrument.

quotes.speaker: Alex/GM
quotes.text: These horns often retain a piece of the dragon's power and make wonderful conduits for arcane magic. The horns make great trophies and can be crafted into various instruments and items.

quotes.speaker: Alex/GM
quotes.text: He's very horny.

best_moments.title: The Breath Pouch — Last Chance
best_moments.description: DC 20 to extract the Draconis Fundamentium — the dragon's breath pouch — without rupturing it. A failure would destroy everything already harvested and nearly kill the harvesters. Valrex had +5 survival. First roll: failed. Used inspiration: failed. Used his last lucky point: failed. Belden's inspiration as a proxy: failed. Final lifeline: Kaelia's Freya's Grace, a reaction spell that let Valrex reroll the check as a Charisma save with her +7 modifier. The roll: 16 + 7 + d4. It worked. The party exhaled as one.

quotes.speaker: Jen/Kaelia
quotes.text: Oh. Oh. No.

quotes.speaker: Alex/GM
quotes.text: You take the full weight of this in your hands.

best_moments.title: Valrex Fails the Heart
best_moments.description: The dragon's heart required a DC 25. Valrex was out of inspirations, out of lucky points, had only guidance. He went for it anyway — his player described Valrex as someone with an addictive personality who 'cannot resist.' He rolled a 1. With guidance: still a 6. Total: 23. Two short. The heart released its residual magic. The dragon's presence pushed through. Tunnel vision — sickly green. His hands clenched involuntarily. A flicker of contempt at the weaker people near him. A possessive curl of fingers toward the dragon parts. 'These are yours.' The seed of Venomfang's pride and malice, lodged where his faith should be. The dragon is dead. But its heart whispers now.

quotes.speaker: Alex/GM
quotes.text: There's this flicker of contempt. And when you look at these weaker people near you, this momentary thrill, the idea of seeing enemies scatter before you. A possessive curl of fingers. When you look at these dragon parts — these are yours. You did all the work. It's not constant. Not yet. But it's there. The seed of Venomfang's pride and malice now lodged where your faith should be. The dragon is dead. But its heart now whispers to you.

quotes.speaker: Darren/Valrex
quotes.text: I've just been someone who definitely has an addictive personality. So this is the best role I've played in the entire game.

best_moments.title: My Dragon Horde
best_moments.description: The first symptom hit almost immediately. Valrex stood covered in blood and viscera, staring north at the tower, and said — out loud, before his conscious mind caught up — 'There's a dragon horde up there. My dragon horde.' Then started walking. Didn't notice no one followed. Semaj reached into his mind via Message: 'Snap out of it.' Valrex turned back, confused, genuinely bewildered that the party wasn't already with him. 'Does it mean we're not going to get the gold? It's going to be our gold.'

quotes.speaker: Alex/GM
quotes.text: You almost hear yourself saying this. There's a dragon horde up there. My dragon horde. Before you even realize you said it.

quotes.speaker: Richard/Semaj
quotes.text: It has begun. I think we have time. Though we can't wait too long. Otherwise, we'll have to kill him in his sleep.

quotes.speaker: Darren/Valrex
quotes.text: Does it mean not go get the gold? It's going to be our gold.

best_moments.title: The Cultists Arrive — Faith Draining in Real Time
best_moments.description: They came in green and black robes with dragon amulets, expecting to serve a living Venomfang. Instead they found the skull detached and staring, the wings cut free and folded on the ground, bones in organized piles, and a dwarf wiping dragon blood off a freshly-hollowed horn. You could see the faith drain out of them in real time. Their leader — Fabric — walked forward with bared teeth: 'What have you done?' Valrex answered by throwing a Guiding Bolt. It fired the wrong color. Green.

quotes.speaker: Alex/GM (as Fabric)
quotes.text: What have you done?

quotes.speaker: Alex/GM
quotes.text: It is a sickly green light. As this radiant energy just rips across this square, you see it glittering now in a green, which used to be a different color.

quotes.speaker: Richard/Semaj
quotes.text: Well, there goes diplomacy.

best_moments.title: Inflict Wounds on Fabric — Session Cliffhanger
best_moments.description: Fabric walked up to Valrex to begin the ritual. They'd agreed to the transfer. He asked, directly: 'Does Venomfang's curse prefer to stay where it is, or are you willing to give it to me?' The word 'give' landed wrong in the cursed mind. The dragon-itch was offended by how much this man wanted what it considered its own. Valrex's hand shot out. He seized Fabric by the throat. Necrotic energy spiderwebbed into the cult leader's skin like dark lightning — still tinted green. Fifteen damage. The cultists pulled swords. Three nat 20s on initiative. Session ends here. Next time: July 25th.

quotes.speaker: Alex/GM
quotes.text: Your hand just shoots out. And you seize Fabric by the throat. Fingers digging into his flesh. And for a heartbeat, his eyes kind of flare with this surprise and fury. As the dark, crackling energy from your grip starts to spiderweb into his skin like lightning.

quotes.speaker: Alex/GM (as Fabric)
quotes.text: You killed our dragon. Now let me become its echo.

quotes.speaker: Sean/Belden
quotes.text: Got 99 problems but a dragon ain't one.
